chunk_read_hex.brief: 从模板文本块读取 `\xHH`（maxk=2）或 `\uXXXX`（maxk=4）/ Read `\xHH` (maxk=2) or `\uXXXX` (maxk=4) from a template chunk

params.maxk: 最多读取的数位个数 / Maximum number of digits to read

chunk_read_hex.return: 读到的码点 / The accumulated code point

chunk_read_hex_braced.brief: 读取 `\u{XXXXX}` 花括号形式 / Read the braced `\u{XXXXX}` form
chunk_read_hex_braced.return: 读到的码点 / The accumulated code point
chunk_read_hex_braced.note: 闭合花括号在此一并消费 / The closing brace is consumed here

chunk_out_cp.brief: 把一个码点以 UTF-8 追加到输出 / Append one code point to the output in UTF-8

params.cap: 输出缓冲区容量 / Output buffer capacity
params.o: inout:已写出的字节数 / Bytes already written
params.cp: 待写入的码点 / Code point to write

chunk_out_cp.note: ASCII 直接写一字节；其余走 `hpe_utf8_encode`，空间不足时丢弃 / ASCII is written directly; others go through `hpe_utf8_encode` and are dropped when the buffer is full

chunk_escape.brief: 解码模板文本块中的一个转义序列 / Decode one escape sequence in a template chunk

params.cap: 输出缓冲区容量 / Output buffer capacity
params.o: inout:已写出的字节数 / Bytes already written

chunk_escape.note: 前导反斜杠已消费；`\n` 续行不输出任何字符 / The leading backslash is consumed; a `\n` line continuation emits nothing

decode_chunk.brief: 解码一个模板文本块的全部转义 / Decode all escapes of one template chunk
decode_chunk.return: 写出的字节数 / The number of bytes written
decode_chunk.note: 输出始终以 NUL 结尾 / The output is always NUL-terminated

parse_sub_expression.brief: 把独立表达式源码解析成 AST / Parse a standalone expression source into an AST
parse_sub_expression.return: 表达式根节点 / The expression root node
parse_sub_expression.note: 用于 `${...}` 替换体；末尾若还有词法单元则报错 / Used for `${...}` substitutions; leftover tokens raise an error

p_template_add_chunk.brief: 向模板节点的 cooked 块列表追加一块 / Append one cooked chunk to a template node

params.node: 模板节点 / The template node
params.start: 块起始下标 / Chunk start offset
params.end: 块结束下标 / Chunk end offset

p_template_add_chunk.note: 偏移相对 `s`；解码转义后作为 `JS_N_STR` 加入 `node->kids[0]` / Offsets are relative to `s`; the decoded text is added as a `JS_N_STR` into `node->kids[0]`

p_template_scan_sub.brief: 越过 `${ … }` 替换体（跳过嵌套花括号/模板/字符串）/ Advance past a `${ … }` substitution, skipping nested braces, templates and strings

params.es: 替换体起始下标（`${` 之后）/ Substitution start offset (past `${`)

p_template_scan_sub.return: 越过闭合 `}` 的下标 / The index just past the closing `}`

p_template.brief: 把 `T_TEMPLATE` 词法单元展开为模板节点 / Expand a `T_TEMPLATE` token into a template node
p_template.return: `JS_N_TEMPLATE` 节点（cooked 块 + 各替换表达式）/ A `JS_N_TEMPLATE` node (cooked chunks plus substitution expressions)
p_template.note: kids[0] 为 cooked 块列表，其后为每个 `${}` 的表达式 / `kids[0]` is the cooked-chunk list, followed by one expression per `${}`

params.need_name: 必须有名返回 1 / 1 when a name is required
params.is_async: async 函数为 1 / 1 for an async function
params.is_gen: 生成器为 1 / 1 for a generator

p_function.return: `JS_N_FUNC` 节点（op 为 `FN_*` 标志，kids[0] 参数、kids[1] 函数体）/ A `JS_N_FUNC` node (op holds `FN_*` flags; kids[0] params, kids[1] body)
p_function.note: 调用时当前词法单元须为 `function` / The current token must be `function`

p_arrow_from_params.brief: 由已解析的参数构造箭头函数 / Build an arrow function from already-parsed parameters

params.is_async: async 箭头为 1 / 1 for an async arrow

p_arrow_from_params.note: 当前词法单元须为 `=>`；非块体转为 `return expr` / The current token must be `=>`; a non-block body becomes `return expr`

p_paren_arrow.brief: 判断 pos 处的 `(` 是否为箭头函数参数表 / Test whether the `(` at `pos` introduces arrow parameters

params.pos: `(` 所在词法单元下标 / Token index of the `(`

p_paren_arrow.return: 是箭头参数表返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it is an arrow parameter list, otherwise 0
p_paren_arrow.note: 用配对扫描做前瞻 / Uses a balanced-scan lookahead

p_arrow_params.brief: 解析 `(params)` 箭头参数表 / Parse a `(params)` arrow parameter list
p_arrow_params.return: 参数块节点（`JS_N_BLOCK`）/ A parameter block node (`JS_N_BLOCK`)

p_private_name.brief: 解析类私有名 `#name` / Parse a private class name `#name`

params.out: out:接收 `#name` 字符串 / Receives the `#name` string

p_private_name.return: 匹配并消费返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when matched and consumed, otherwise 0
p_private_name.note: 结果从 arena 分配 / The result is allocated from the arena

p_property_name.brief: 解析一个属性名（含计算名与私有名）/ Parse a property name (computed and private included)

params.out: out:接收静态属性名字符串 / Receives the static property name string
params.computed: out:接收 `[expr]` 计算名节点，无则置 `NULL` / Receives the `[expr]` computed node, set to `NULL` when absent

p_property_name.return: 解析成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on success, otherwise 0
p_property_name.note: 覆盖标识符/字符串/数字键、`[expr]` 与 `#private` / Covers identifier/string/number keys, `[expr]` and `#private`

p_obj_accessor_flags.brief: 识别对象方法的 `get`/`set` 前缀 / Recognise the `get`/`set` prefixes of an object method
p_obj_accessor_flags.note: 仅当后面跟着名字（非 `:`/`,`/`}`/`(`）才生效，使 `{get: 1}`、`{get}` 保持普通属性 / Only applies when a name follows (not `:`/`,`/`}`/`(`), keeping `{get: 1}` and `{get}` plain properties

p_obj_async_prefix.brief: 识别对象方法的 `async` / `async *` 前缀 / Recognise the `async` / `async *` prefixes of an object method

p_obj_member_prefix.brief: 识别一个对象属性前的全部成员修饰前缀 / Detect all member-modifier prefixes of one object property
p_obj_member_prefix.note: 依次处理 `async`、`get`/`set` 与 `*` / Handles `async`, `get`/`set` and `*` in order

p_obj_method.brief: 解析 `key(...) { … }` 方法简写 / Parse the `key(...) { … }` method shorthand

params.obj: inout:对象节点 / The object node
params.computed: 计算名节点，可为 `NULL` / Computed-name node, may be `NULL`

p_obj_method.note: 访问器/方法标志写入 `pair->op` 与函数 op / Accessor/method flags go into `pair->op` and the function's op

p_obj_colon_prop.brief: 解析 `key: value` 数据属性 / Parse a `key: value` data property

params.obj: inout:对象节点 / The object node
params.computed: 计算名节点，可为 `NULL` / Computed-name node, may be `NULL`

p_obj_colon_prop.note: 字面量 `__proto__` 被识别为原型属性 / A literal `__proto__` is recognised as a prototype property

p_obj_shorthand_prop.brief: 解析 `key` 或 `key = default` 简写属性 / Parse a `key` or `key = default` shorthand property

params.obj: inout:对象节点 / The object node

p_obj_shorthand_prop.note: 带默认值的形式仅用于解构 / The defaulted form is only valid in destructuring

p_object_props.brief: 解析对象字面量的成员列表 / Parse the member list of an object literal

params.obj: inout:对象节点 / The object node

p_object_props.note: 支持 `...spread`、方法、访问器、简写与计算名；`{` 已被消费 / Supports `...spread`, methods, accessors, shorthands and computed names; the `{` is already consumed

p_next_ends_member.brief: 判断下一个词法单元是否结束成员名 / Test whether the next token ends a member name
p_next_ends_member.return: 下一词法单元为 `(`、`=` 或 `;` 返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the next token is `(`, `=` or `;`, otherwise 0
p_next_ends_member.note: 若是，则前面的单词是普通字段名而非修饰关键字 / If so, the preceding word is a plain field name rather than a modifier keyword

p_class_static_prefix.brief: 识别类成员的 `static` 前缀 / Recognise the `static` prefix of a class member
p_class_static_prefix.note: `static` 后面为 `(`/`=` 时不当作前缀 / `static` followed by `(`/`=` is not treated as a prefix

p_class_member_prefix.brief: 收集一个类成员前的全部修饰前缀 / Collect all modifier prefixes preceding one class member

p_class_static_block.brief: 解析 `static { … }` 类静态初始化块 / Parse a `static { … }` class initialiser block

params.members: inout:类成员列表 / The class member list

p_class_static_block.note: 语句被加入以 `JS_STATIC_BLOCK` 标记的块节点 / Statements go into a block node flagged `JS_STATIC_BLOCK`

p_class_method_kind.brief: 判定类成员的方法种类标签 / Compute the method-kind tag of a class member

params.computed: 计算名节点，可为 `NULL` / Computed-name node, may be `NULL`

p_class_method_kind.note: 非计算名且名字为 `constructor` 视为构造器 / A `constructor` name that is not computed counts as the constructor

p_class_method.brief: 解析 `name(params) { … }` 类方法（或构造器）/ Parse a `name(params) { … }` class method (or constructor)

params.members: inout:类成员列表 / The class member list
params.computed: 计算名节点，可为 `NULL` / Computed-name node, may be `NULL`

p_class_method.note: 构造器叠加 `FN_CTOR`；方法种类写入 `fn->num` / The constructor adds `FN_CTOR`; the method kind lands in `fn->num`

p_class_field.brief: 解析 `name = value;` 类字段（值可省）/ Parse a `name = value;` class field (value optional)

params.members: inout:类成员列表 / The class member list
params.computed: 计算名节点，可为 `NULL` / Computed-name node, may be `NULL`

p_class_field.note: 静态字段用 `JS_MEMBER_STATIC_FIELD`，实例字段用 `JS_MEMBER_FIELD` / Static fields use `JS_MEMBER_STATIC_FIELD`, instance fields `JS_MEMBER_FIELD`

p_class_body.brief: 解析类体（`{` 为当前词法单元）/ Parse a class body (the `{` is current)
p_class_body.note: 成员列表加入 `cls`；`;` 空成员被跳过 / The member list is added to `cls`; empty `;` members are skipped

p_class.brief: 解析 `class [name] [extends expr] { body }` / Parse `class [name] [extends expr] { body }`
p_class.note: 调用时当前词法单元须为 `class`；kids[0] 为父类或 `NULL` / The current token must be `class`; kids[0] holds the superclass or `NULL`

p_call_args.brief: 解析 CallExpression 的 `(arg, ...spread)` 实参表 / Parse the `(arg, ...spread)` argument list of a call

params.call: inout:调用节点 / The call node

p_call_args.note: 实参逐个加入 `call`；`...spread` 包成 `JS_N_SPREAD` / Arguments are added to `call`; `...spread` becomes a `JS_N_SPREAD`

p_member_dot.brief: 解析 `.name` / `.#private` 成员访问 / Parse a `.name` / `.#private` member access

params.base: 被访问的基础表达式 / The base expression

p_member_dot.note: 调用时当前词法单元须为 `.` 且属性名紧随 / The current token must be `.` with the property name right after

p_member_index.brief: 解析 `[expr]` 下标访问 / Parse a `[expr]` index access

params.base: 被访问的基础表达式 / The base expression
params.optional: 可选链访问为 1 / 1 for an optional-chain access

p_member_optional.brief: 解析 `?.` 可选访问（调用/下标/点名）/ Parse a `?.` optional access (call, index or dotted name)

params.base: 被访问的基础表达式 / The base expression
params.allow_call: 允许调用为 1 / 1 to allow a call

p_member_optional.return: 可选调用、可选下标或可选成员节点 / An optional call, optional index or optional member node
p_member_optional.note: 调用时当前词法单元须为 `?.` / The current token must be `?.`

p_member_tail.brief: 解析 MemberExpression 的尾部链 / Parse the tail chain of a MemberExpression

params.base: 基础表达式 / The base expression
params.allow_call: 允许 `(args)` 调用为 1 / 1 to allow `(args)` calls

p_member_tail.return: 链接完成后的表达式节点 / The fully chained expression node
p_member_tail.note: `new` 以 allow_call=0 解析被调者，使 `new Date(0).getTime()` 绑定为 `(new Date(0)).getTime()` / `new` parses its callee with calls disabled so `new Date(0).getTime()` binds as `(new Date(0)).getTime()`

p_super_expr.brief: 解析 `super` 后的 `(args)`、`.name` 或 `[expr]` / Parse `super` followed by `(args)`, `.name` or `[expr]`
p_super_expr.return: `JS_N_SUPER_CALL` 或 `JS_N_SUPER_MEMBER` 节点 / A `JS_N_SUPER_CALL` or `JS_N_SUPER_MEMBER` node
p_super_expr.warning: `super` 后不是 `(`/`.`/`[` 时报错 / Errors when `super` is not followed by `(`, `.` or `[`

p_async_expr.brief: 解析 async 函数/箭头形式 / Parse the async function or async arrow forms
p_async_expr.return: `JS_N_FUNC` 节点；不是 async 形式时返回 `NULL` / A `JS_N_FUNC` node, or `NULL` when it is not an async form
p_async_expr.note: 覆盖 `async function`、`async x =>` 与 `async (…) =>` / Covers `async function`, `async x =>` and `async (…) =>`

p_import_meta.return: 一个 `JS_N_OBJECT` 节点（占位对象）/ A `JS_N_OBJECT` node (a placeholder object)
p_import_meta.note: 动态 `import()` 不受支持 / Dynamic `import()` is not supported

p_single_arrow.brief: 构造单参数箭头 `name => ...` / Build a single-parameter arrow `name => ...`

params.name: 参数名 / Parameter name
params.is_async: async 箭头为 1 / 1 for an async arrow

p_ident_primary.brief: 解析由关键字引导的初级表达式 / Resolve keyword-led primary expressions
p_ident_primary.return: 字面量、super、function/class、箭头等节点；普通标识符返回 `NULL` / A literal, `super`, function/class or arrow node; `NULL` means a plain identifier
p_ident_primary.note: 覆盖 `true`/`false`/`null`/`this`/`super`/`function`/`async`/`class`/`new`/`import.meta` 与单参箭头 / Covers `true`/`false`/`null`/`this`/`super`/`function`/`async`/`class`/`new`/`import.meta` and single-parameter arrows

p_array_literal.brief: 解析带空位与展开的 `[…]` 数组字面量 / Parse a `[…]` array literal with holes and spread

p_paren_expr.brief: 解析 `(expr)` 或括号化箭头参数表 / Parse `(expr)` or a parenthesised arrow parameter list
p_paren_expr.return: 括起的表达式节点，或箭头函数节点 / The parenthesised expression, or an arrow function node

p_primary.brief: 解析初级表达式 / Parse a primary expression
p_primary.return: 数字、字符串、正则、模板、标识符、括号、数组或对象字面量节点 / A number, string, regex, template, identifier, parenthesised, array or object literal node
p_primary.warning: 遇到 `T_EOF` 或意外词法单元时报错 / Errors on `T_EOF` or an unexpected token

p_postfix.brief: 解析后缀 `++`/`--` 表达式 / Parse a postfix `++`/`--` expression
p_postfix.return: 更新表达式节点或初级表达式结果 / An update-expression node, or the primary result
p_postfix.note: 仅当运算符与操作数同行时才算后缀更新 / Only counts as a postfix update when the operator is on the same line as its operand

p_unwrap_prefix.brief: 构造包裹操作数的前缀一元节点 / Build a prefix unary node wrapping its operand

params.kind: 节点种类（`JS_N_UN`、`JS_N_AWAIT` 等）/ Node kind (`JS_N_UN`, `JS_N_AWAIT`, …)

p_unwrap_prefix.return: 新建的一元节点 / The new unary node

p_yield.note: `yield*` 置 `op=1`；其后为终止符或换行时省略操作数 / `yield*` sets `op=1`; the operand is omitted when a terminator or a newline follows

p_new_expr.brief: 解析 `new` 表达式（被调者、实参与方法尾）/ Parse a `new` expression (callee, arguments and method tail)
p_new_expr.return: `JS_N_NEW` 或更外层的成员/调用节点 / A `JS_N_NEW` node, possibly wrapped by further member/call nodes
p_new_expr.note: 以 allow_call=0 解析被调者，使后续 `(...)` 归属于 `new` / The callee is parsed with calls disabled so a following `(...)` belongs to `new`

p_unary.brief: 解析一元表达式 / Parse a unary expression
p_unary.return: 一元、更新、`yield`、`new` 或后缀表达式的结果节点 / The result of a unary, update, `yield`, `new` or postfix expression
p_unary.note: 覆盖 `! - + ~ typeof void delete await yield new` 与前置 `++`/`--` / Covers `! - + ~ typeof void delete await yield new` and prefix `++`/`--`

p_bin_make.brief: 构造一个二元运算节点 / Build a binary-operation node

p_exp.brief: 解析指数运算 `**`（右结合）/ Parse the exponentiation operator `**` (right-associative)
p_exp.return: 一元表达式或指数节点 / A unary expression or an exponentiation node

p_mul.brief: 解析乘性运算 `* / %` / Parse the multiplicative operators `* / %`
p_mul.return: 乘法层的表达式节点 / The multiplicative-level expression node

p_add.brief: 解析加减运算 `+ -` / Parse the additive operators `+ -`
p_add.return: 加法层的表达式节点 / The additive-level expression node

p_shift.brief: 解析移位运算 `<< >> >>>` / Parse the shift operators `<< >> >>>`
p_shift.return: 移位层的表达式节点 / The shift-level expression node

p_rel.brief: 解析关系与成员运算 `< > <= >= instanceof in` / Parse relational and membership operators `< > <= >= instanceof in`
p_rel.return: 关系层的表达式节点 / The relational-level expression node

p_eq.brief: 解析相等运算 `== != === !==` / Parse the equality operators `== != === !==`
p_eq.return: 相等层的表达式节点 / The equality-level expression node

p_band.brief: 解析按位与 `&` / Parse bitwise AND, `&`
p_band.return: 按位与层的表达式节点 / The bitwise-AND-level expression node

p_bxor.brief: 解析按位异或 `^` / Parse bitwise XOR, `^`
p_bxor.return: 按位异或层的表达式节点 / The bitwise-XOR-level expression node

p_bor.brief: 解析按位或 `|` / Parse bitwise OR, `|`
p_bor.return: 按位或层的表达式节点 / The bitwise-OR-level expression node

p_and.brief: 解析逻辑与 `&&` / Parse logical AND, `&&`
p_and.return: 逻辑与层的表达式节点 / The logical-AND-level expression node

p_or.brief: 解析逻辑或 `||` / Parse logical OR, `||`
p_or.return: 逻辑或层的表达式节点 / The logical-OR-level expression node

p_nullish.brief: 解析空值合并 `??`（右结合）/ Parse the nullish-coalescing operator `??` (right-associative)
p_nullish.return: 空值合并层的表达式节点 / The nullish-coalescing-level expression node

p_ternary.brief: 解析条件（三元）表达式 `?:` / Parse the conditional (ternary) expression `?:`
p_ternary.return: `JS_N_TERNARY` 节点或条件表达式 / A `JS_N_TERNARY` node or the condition expression

p_assignment.brief: 解析赋值表达式 / Parse an assignment expression
p_assignment.return: `JS_N_ASSIGN` 节点或三元表达式 / A `JS_N_ASSIGN` node or the ternary expression
p_assignment.note: 覆盖 `=` 与全部复合赋值（含 `&&=`/`||=`/`??=`）；右结合 / Covers `=` and every compound assignment (including `&&=`, `||=`, `??=`); right-associative

p_expr.brief: 解析（逗号）表达式 / Parse a (comma) expression
p_expr.return: `JS_N_SEQ` 序列节点，或单个赋值表达式 / A `JS_N_SEQ` sequence node, or a single assignment expression

p_assign_target.brief: 解析 for 头部的赋值目标 / Parse the target of a `for` head
p_assign_target.return: 表达式节点 / The expression node
p_assign_target.note: 当前等同于 `p_expr`，形参与解构在 `p_binding_target` 处理 / Currently equivalent to `p_expr`; destructuring is handled by `p_binding_target`
